Italian Chicken Roll Ups
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 12:25am

Ingredients




1 can cream of mushroom soup
1 cup shredded Mozzarella cheese
2 cups boneless chicken chopped into small chunks
Italian spices to taste
10 lasagna noodles
Spaghetti sauce

Preparation

1 Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. While this is cooking, mix ingredients together (thick mixture). Spread a thin mixture on a flat noodle and roll up. Place open side down in baking dish and cover noodles with spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour. Serves 8 to 10.
